CustomField.label: Expected Formula (on this record)
CustomField.description: A Salesforce formula that produces the value to compare against, based on the current record. Used only when Expected Value Comes From is "A formula on this record". Formula syntax only — not Apex or SOQL.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Salesforce formula giving the value to compare against, e.g. BillingCity or AnnualRevenue / 10. Used when Expected Value Comes From is "A formula on this record".
